candidates.name: LIAR
candidates.publisher_or_creator: William Yang Wang / UCSB research release; statements sourced from PolitiFact according to the dataset documentation
candidates.published_revision: Original LIAR release; exact archive revision not independently recorded in this audit
candidates.provenance_evidence: Official paper and dataset documentation identify 12.8K PolitiFact-labeled short statements and six truthfulness labels.
candidates.structure_and_suitability: Short claim-level English statements; six labels; suitable for a distinct claim-classification task, not a drop-in article-level binary replacement.
restrictions_and_caveats: PolitiFact-originated statements and analysis text may involve third-party rights.
No reviewed official license text establishes commercial, hosting, model-distribution, or raw-redistribution rights.
Task labels and source domain differ materially from the current binary article corpus.
evidence_gaps: Authenticated archive digest and acquisition record
Permission covering derived artifacts and public hosting
Clarification of PolitiFact and third-party content rights

candidates.name: r/Fakeddit
candidates.publisher_or_creator: Kai Nakamura, Sharon Levy, and William Yang Wang / UCSB lab project
candidates.published_revision: README documents v2.0 download instructions; exact data-file revision digest not established
candidates.provenance_evidence: Official repository documents v2.0 text/metadata, image, and comment sources, public test material, and usage guidance.
candidates.structure_and_suitability: Over one million Reddit-derived multimodal samples in the project description; text, metadata, comments, and image components. Suitable only after defining a new task and content policy.
restrictions_and_caveats: Reddit submissions, comments, images, URLs, and user-linked metadata may have separate terms and privacy concerns.
Official usage instructions say to read usage guidance and distinguish multimodal-only evaluation samples.
No dataset license was verified in the reviewed repository pages.
evidence_gaps: Dataset license or rights statement attached to v2.0 files
Permission for model distribution, hosting, commercial use, and raw redistribution
Third-party Reddit/media rights and privacy review

candidates.name: CoAID: COVID-19 Healthcare Misinformation Dataset
candidates.provenance_evidence: Official README records version history and describes 5,216 news items, 296,752 engagements, 958 social posts, and labels.
candidates.structure_and_suitability: COVID-19 healthcare misinformation domain; not a general fake-news replacement and likely requires a different label/task contract.
restrictions_and_caveats: Healthcare claims and social content require domain, privacy, and third-party rights review.
No dataset license or model-distribution permission was found in the reviewed official README.
Version history exists, but no source-file digest was established.
evidence_gaps: Authenticated file digest and acquisition record
Rights in article, social-platform, and engagement content

candidates.name: FakeNewsNet
candidates.publisher_or_creator: Kai Shu and collaborators; Arizona Board of Regents copyright notice in repository
candidates.published_revision: Repository distinguishes current version and old-version branch; exact acquisition revision not selected
candidates.published_license: No general dataset license identified in the reviewed README
candidates.provenance_evidence: Official README describes Politifact/GossipCop sources, minimal CSV metadata, collection scripts, Twitter API dependencies, and current/old versions.
candidates.structure_and_suitability: News-source and social-context records; CSV metadata includes IDs, URLs, titles, and tweet IDs. Not a direct replacement for the current four-column binary files.
restrictions_and_caveats: Official README states the complete dataset cannot be distributed because of Twitter privacy policies and news publisher copyrights.
Collection requires external APIs and may retrieve publisher content; current availability and terms can change.
The documented restriction applies to complete redistribution; other uses still require separate rights review.
evidence_gaps: Permission for the intended training and hosting scope
Current source and API terms, file digests, and acquisition record
Third-party publisher and Twitter content rights

global_limitations: No candidate was downloaded or parsed.
Public availability and repository ownership were not treated as proof of rights.
No candidate is authorized for acquisition, training, model distribution, hosting, or raw redistribution.
Legal conclusions require qualified review of exact terms and content rights.
